backupDescription: Includes SDLC workflows, Agents and versions, Squads, repository relationships, memories, Skills and packages, member access, integrations and scheduled task configuration. Excludes work items, executions, conversations, reviews, logs and usage. Only credential references are retained; rebind credentials after migration.

rolesHint: Each member has one role. Changes apply to every assigned member. Built-in names are fixed and built-in roles cannot be deleted; Collaborator feature permissions can be adjusted.
rolePermissionHint: Read only allows viewing. Read/write also allows the create, edit, and delete actions supported by that feature. Member, role, and credential management still require an administrator.
readOnlyDomainsHint: These choices apply to everyone with this role, in both the web app and MCP tools.

readOnlyFeatures.advancedHint: These features currently have no standard menu entry. Their permissions still apply to their APIs. Collapsing this section preserves selections.

description.WORKITEM: Work items: lists, details, creation, editing, assignment, and status actions.
description.SCHEDULEDTASK: Scheduled tasks: configuration, run history, and documents. Requires workspace support.
description.DISPATCH: Execution records: details, dispatch, retries, recovery, and human approvals and Q&A during execution.
description.ARTIFACT: Requirement documents and delivery artifacts in work item details, including upload, preview, and download.
description.CLARIFICATION: Structured clarification results and pending questions in work item details.
description.CONVERSATION: Platform assistant chats and clarification conversations in work item details.
description.DEBUGLOG: Squad debug logs in work item details for troubleshooting execution.
description.AGENT: Agents → Management: agent configuration, versions, publishing, and reviews.
description.SQUAD: Agents → Management → Squads: squad configuration and membership.
description.EXECUTOR: Executors: connection status, configuration, start/stop, and upgrades.
description.REPO: Repositories: repository details, credentials, and relationships.
description.MEMORY: Memory: content, directories, topics, and imports.
description.SKILL: Capabilities: viewing and managing skills, versions, and skill packages.
description.CATEGORY: The category tree and category management on the Capabilities page; separate from skill content.
description.SDLC: SDLC workflows: configuration, steps, enabling, disabling, and deletion.
description.TEMPLATE: SDLC workflows → Template gallery: browse and apply presets. Applying requires write access to SDLC workflows, agents and squads.
description.STATEMACHINE: Status templates: available work item statuses and the transitions between them.
description.INTEGRATION: Platform integrations: work item platform bindings, import/sync, messaging channel bindings, and Aone deployment actions.
description.WORKSPACE: Member and role management, join-request approvals, and workspace changes. Administrative operations require an administrator.
description.BACKUP: Project configuration backups: create, view and download. Administrators only.
description.ENVIRONMENT: Environment variables: list, create, edit and delete. Saved values are not exposed for viewing or copying on the management page.
description.DASHBOARD: Data insights → Realtime dashboard: agent activity, running tasks, and completion counts.
description.INSIGHTS: Data insights → Human–AI collaboration and Work item delivery. Data remains viewable.
description.AUDIT: Audit logs: view workspace operation records. Logs are always retained.
description.AI: Assisted SDLC generation, repository scanning, and AI clarification sessions. Some entries are not yet available; this does not disable all agent execution.
description.AIUSAGE: Call usage and quotas under System settings → AI configuration. The System settings menu is currently hidden.
description.SETTING: AI, notification, and system defaults in System settings. The menu is currently hidden; personal preferences are separate.
description.EVOLUTION: Self-evolution: improvement proposals, validation, releases, and rollbacks. The menu is currently hidden.
